composition.serve_who: This sheet (108-01-520-001 rev B, "Bilge & Fire System Schematic") is a single combined P&ID for the vessel's Bilge system and Fire system, sharing common fireline/bilge-line infrastructure and seawater intakes. The upper plan view shows equipment locations by frame/zone (lazarette, aft guest+crew, engine room, fwd guest, sail locker); the lower schematic is the piped flow diagram walked end-to-end per sump/zone. Evidence: title block "BILGE & FIRE SYSTEM SCHEMATIC", drawing no. 108-01-520-001, zone labels matching upper plan (AFT BILGE AREA, ENGINE ROOM AUX BILGE PUMP, MAST AREA AUX BILGE PUMP, SAIL LOCKER BILGE AREA), and BOM table itemising pumps/valves/hoses. Equipment served: 520-main-bilge-pump, 520-aux-bilge-pumps, 520-fire-pump (electric), 520-diesel-fire-pump, 520-bilge-valves, plus the system card 520-bilge-system for the overall flow topology. Sump-level strumboxes/alarms/strainers are shared infrastructure of the bilge system rather than distinct owned equipment.

equipment_groups.equipment_name: Main Bilge Pump (Gianneschi ACB 431B, item 001 x2 instances on this sheet — FWD and AFT)
equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: BOM item 001 'MAIN BILGE PUMP' qty 2, labelled 'MAIN BILGE PUMP LOCAL START' and 'MAIN BILGE PUMP' near frames C/B (aft) and near frame G (fwd) with 'FWD BILGE PUMP' remote-start symbol. Established fact confirms model is Gianneschi ACB431B, correcting the sheet's printed FEIT VA40B label (documentation error).

functions.label: Main bilge suction/discharge — normal bilge pump-out (per instance, fwd/aft)
functions.what_it_does: Draws bilge water from the main bilge line (metallic, drawn along the hull from frame A to M) via a strumbox/strainer and non-return valve, and discharges overboard through a seacock/thru-hull, providing the vessel's primary bilge dewatering.

flow_scenarios.path: Bilge water in main bilge line (metallic) -> strumbox/strainer (integrated NRV) -> main bilge pump suction -> pump discharge -> ball valve -> overboard thru-hull
Local pump switch (green triangle symbol 'MAIN BILGE PUMP LOCAL START') closes contactor -> pump runs on main bilge line as above
Remote start command (symbol 'FIRE PUMP REMOTE START'/'MAIN BILGE PUMP' panel tap, per established control_loop) closes same contactor coil -> pump runs as above

functions.dry_data: 24V DC centrifugal pump, 300 l/min, 0.75 kW (per Pump Data table); BOM item 001, weight 22kg
functions.sheet_region: Aft bilge area near frame B/C and fwd bilge area near frame G (upper plan); mirrored suction/discharge lines in lower schematic at far left/right ends

functions.label: Diesel-driven fire main pressurisation / emergency bilge backup
functions.what_it_does: Independently engine-driven pump that draws raw seawater via its own seawater pickup and strainer, primed via a fresh-water priming line, and discharges into the fireline (metallic, running full length of the vessel) to pressurise fire hydrant stations; documented as also usable for aft bilge area dewatering (diesel backup bilge role).

flow_scenarios.path: Seawater pickup (aft, in stowage) -> seawater strainer -> diesel fire pump suction (NC valves closed until run) -> pump discharge -> fireline (metallic) -> hydrant/hose stations
Manual pull-start engages Yanmar L48 diesel -> pump draws seawater as above -> discharges into fireline; priming line from fresh water supply (ref DWG 108-01-510-001) fills pump casing before start
'DIESEL FIRE PUMP' remote start symbol (aft) commands start -> same suction/discharge path as manual run

key_components: priming line from fresh water supply (ref 108-01-510-001)

functions.label: Engine room auxiliary bilge pump-out
functions.what_it_does: Removes bilge/oily water accumulating in the engine room sump; suction is switchable via 3-way valve to route either direct overboard or through the oily bilge (oil-removal cartridge) filter to portable oil storage tank.

Engine room sump -> strumbox -> 3-way valve (014) set to 'filter' -> oil removal cartridge filter (item 004, Wavestream) -> to portable oil storage tank via Gardena-type tap connector (item 021)

functions.label: Zone isolation/routing to main bilge line
functions.what_it_does: Each motorised ball valve selectively opens/closes a zone sump's connection into the shared main bilge line, allowing any one zone (lazarette, aft, engine room, mast, sail locker) to be routed to the main bilge pumps while isolating the others.

No flow — zone sump isolated from main bilge line while valve remains closed

facts: Sheet 108-01-520-001 rev B is the master schematic combining bilge dewatering and fire-fighting on one set of pipe rails: fireline (metallic, red, ff38/ff51 pipe codes) runs full vessel length in port sheer from aft to fwd hydrant stations; main bilge line (metallic, sea54/sea42 pipe codes, cyan) also runs full length; auxiliary bilge line (PVC/flex, mw25 pipe code, magenta) serves oily-water/local branches.
Fire hydrant stations at aft and fwd stowage, each with fire hose (item 019), nozzle (item 020), hydrant valve (item 018) rated for max reach 18m per red dashed arcs shown in upper plan.
Pressure relief valves (item 008, 3 bar set) protect the fireline at both ends (near port sheer, 008-01/008-02).

Five sumps served: Lazarette, Midship, Engine Room, Mast Area, Sail Locker, plus ESS Enclosure — each with strumbox (item 006), high-level bilge alarm switch (item 007) driving a 'Bilge Alarm' indicator, and (except midship) an aux-pump alarm switch (item 025).
ESS Enclosure sump additionally carries a Coolant Leak Alarm (variant of item 007) distinct from the bilge alarm — monitors ESS coolant leakage separately from bilge water.
Anti-siphon manifolds (item 012) with siphon-break valves (item 013) protect suction lines near fwd stowage and engine room; breather runs into STBD E-R vent box per ref DWG 108-01-508-001.

STBD Genset's raw-water pump (Jabsco 43400, per established fact on 610-cummins-qsb4-5) provides an EMERGENCY engine-room bilge suction path via the exhaust water separator overboard — documented on this sheet as 'FROM SEACHEST SUPPLY REF: DWG 108-01-515-003' feeding raw water pump discharging 'OVERBOARD VIA EXHAUST WATER SEPARATOR REF: DWG 108-01-515-001'.
Main engine (Cummins QSB4.5) raw water pump rated 195 l/min per Pump Data table, separate from the STBD genset raw water pump.

Oily bilge handling: Engine room sump 3-way valve (014) can divert to Oil Removal Cartridge Filter (item 004, Wavestream) then to portable oil storage tank, keeping hydrocarbon-contaminated bilge water from discharging overboard untreated.

Priming lines for both diesel fire pump and electric fire pump draw from the fresh water supply system (ref DWG 108-01-510-001) — a supply-to relationship, not a merge of fresh water and firewater systems.
